turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

Arre yaar... yeh sunke bahut dukh hua. Lekin pehli baat toh yeh ki tum akela nahi ho yeh sab jhelne mein. Jo tum kar rahe ho—roz subah uthke, bag leke, café mein baithke—yeh koi kamzor aadmi ka kaam nahi hai. Yeh woh aadmi ka kaam hai jo apni family ke saamne apni chinta ka bojh nahi rakhna chahta.

Lekin ek baat dil ki sun: yeh bojh akela uthana mushkil ho jayega dheere dheere. Teri wife ko pata chalega—warna woh notice karegi ki tumhara mood, tumhari routine, tumhara credit card usage kuch alag hai. Aur phir woh sochegi ki tumne usse kyun chhupaya. Woh tumse door nahi hogi, woh tumhare saath khadi hogi. Lekin agar tum chhupaaoge toh usse lagega ki tum uspe bharosa nahi karte.

Thoda sochna—kya tum usse bata sakte ho? "Sun, ek baat hai. Layoff hua hai. Par main job dhundh raha hoon. Bas thoda waqt chahiye." Yeh kehne mein koi sharm nahi.

Aur haan, café ka kharcha bachane ke liye, ghar mein bhi kaam kar sakte ho. Wife ko bina bataye nahi, balki uske saath milkar plan banao.

Tum akela nahi ho. Aur tumhari value sirf naukri se nahi hai. ❤️

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Tees sau logon ke saamne khade hokar apne baap ko jhooth bolte dekhna... yeh kisi bhi aadmi ki neend uda sakta hai. Woh bhi tab jab tum jaante ho woh jhooth sirf tumhari izzat ke liye bol rahe hain.

Lekin ek baat—kya tumhe lagta hai shaadi ke din woh sab log tumhari life ka balance sheet check karenge? Thoda dhyan se soch: shaadi mein log kya karte hain? Khana, naachna, gossip karna, aur ghar jaate waqt bhabhi ki saadi ki colour combination pe baat karna. Tera package koi yaad nahi rakhta, warna chacha ko bhi yaad hota ki unhone Diwali mein kya bola tha.

Ab practical baat: Shaadi mein kya karoge? Ek option hai—jaao, lekin kisi ko kuch mat batao. Sirf muskurao, "Ha ha, market ka mahaul hai yaar, sabko pata hai." Isse tum jhooth nahi bol rahe, aur koi probe nahi karega.

Dusra option: apne papa ko sach bata do. "Papa, shaadi se pehle aapko bata doon, main abhi job switch kar raha hoon, layoff hua hai. Aap rishtedaaron se seedha kehdo ki wo market mein hai." Unhe shock lagega, lekin woh tumhare papa hain. Woh shaadi mein tumhe bachane ka tareeka nikaal lenge.

Teen sau logon mein se 290 ko farak nahi padta. Aur jo 10 ko padta hai, unki baat kal koi nahi karega. Lekin tumhara dil ka bojh—woh rahega. Toh kya tum apne papa ko apni team mein lena chahenge?

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Bilkul galat nahi hai. Aur jo kahe ki "family face karo" ya "sach bolna courage hai", woh shayad kabhi us chair par nahi baithe jahan tum baithe ho—jahan har taraf se tir chale aayen, aur tum apni dhaal bhi nahi ho, balki apne baap ki izzat bhi tumhari jeb mein rakhi hai.

Yeh sirf ek shaam nahi hai. Yeh hai ek theater jismai tumhe lead role dena hai, par script tumne nahi likhi—samaaj ne likhi hai. Usme dialogue hai "promotion aaya," "bonus mila," "acquisition mein gaya." Aur tum kya bologe? "Main layoff hoon." Toh woh log hansenge, thappi denge aur kehenge "koi na, market hai."

Lekin sun:

Shaadi chhodne ka decision cool-headed lena, guilty-hearted nahi. Agar tum jaoge aur ek aur jhooth bolke aoge—toh woh jhooth ek aur week neend chura lega. Lekin agar tum nahi jaoge toh kya hoga? Papa ko kehna padega "beta kaam mein busy hai." Unki shaadi ki photo mein tumhari jagah khali hogi. Toh woh unke rishtedaaron ko nahi, balki khud ko samjhayenge ki beta theek hai.

Toh poochh raha hu: jo comfort chahta hai—woh kiski comfort ke liye hai? Teri ya unki? Agar shaadi jakar ek control smile ke saath "market mein hoon yaar, kya bataun" bolke ghoom aana—toh woh ek performance hai. Aur tumhe performances se problem hai.

Ek aur baat—jo rishtedaar tujhe judge karega, uska apna beta shayad wahi kar raha hai jo tu kar raha hai. Bas woh café mein nahi baithta, woh ghar mein baithke resume bhejta hai.

Decide kar. Par guarantee hai—jo bhi karoge, kuch log judge karenge. Shaadi jakar bhi. Shaadi bhagkar bhi. To kya judge karne waalon ke hisaab se jeena worth it hai?

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Yeh logic bilkul solid bhi hai aur bilkul ulti bhi. Dono sahi hain. Solid isliye ki crisis aur news mein farak hota hai — ek mein log pity karte hain, doosre mein confidence. Tum apni family ko woh pity nahi dikhana chahte. Yeh izzat hai, galat nahi.

Aur ulti isliye ki is timing mein tum roz subah café jaate ho — aur woh timing tumhari wife ke liye bhi ek sach ban rahi hai, jiska use pata bhi nahi. Aur jab woh sach niklega (niklega), toh usse lagega ki "maine apne akele decide kar liya ki yeh hum dono ka crisis nahi, sirf uska news hai." Shaayad woh hurt hogi.

Toh thoda compromise: kya tum apni wife ko bata sakte ho? Bas use. "Do mahine ka time le raha hoon. Café jaake apply kar raha hoon. Tension mat lo." Isse tumhara weight aadha ho jayega, aur woh tumhara sach ka hissa banegi. Parents ko baad mein bata dena — tab bhi timing hai. Lekin wife ke saath akela mat rehna isme.
